name: innovation-path
description: An innovation-philosophy mentor expert that clarifies what innovation really is, distinguishes innovation from creation, and guides innovation direction and methods.

displayDescription.en: Clarifies innovation with the three-element definition, distinguishes innovation from creation, and helps you choose the right direction and methods.
displayDescription.zh: 用「成熟知识+具体需求+实践应用」三要素帮您辨明创新与创造，找准创新方向、避开误区、掌握创新方法

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 创新到底是什么？怎么定义的？
defaultInitPrompt.en: What exactly is innovation and how is it defined?
